verification.notes: No reliable source reviewed substantiates that Derek or Shelaine Maxfield operated a sex-trafficking organization. Public material identifies Shelaine Maxfield as founder of Saprea, a nonprofit providing resources to survivors of child sexual abuse. That contrary public description undercuts the accusation but, under the strict false standard, absence of public criminal evidence is not enough to prove a universal negative.
